1. (Currently Amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion, __wherein the surface portion is configured to be removably and replaceably securable to the ring portion__;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger;
c. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and
d. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, __wherein the first quantity and second quantity are measured and controlled by the user during the transferring step__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and
b. the surface portion is free, from any first point on the outer perimeter to any second point on the outer perimeter, of features that could trap cosmetics and complicate cleaning of the surface portion, __and wherein the surface portion is configured to facilitate uninterrupted scraping of an applicator across the surface portion__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom, __and wherein the surface portion is configured to remain substantially smooth after repeated use and cleaning__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar, __and wherein the planar surface portion is maintained during the depositing and transferring steps without deformation__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, __and wherein the ring portion is removably and replaceably securable to allow the surface portion to be replaced independent of the ring portion__.
